title: About A Creature, Interrupted
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 3 recent saved-signal files and 2 captured links, then narrowed the page to 1 source windows around @gucci4mycat: I'm afraid LORA training (only based on my irl paintings) was on my bingo for this.... A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A Creature, Interrupted: Landscape painting: two separated pink catlike fragment groups across a broad pale interval. A hot-pink ear and large cream-haloed charcoal pupil face a smaller ear, eye and vermilion mouth arc edged violet-blue. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 1 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against Ragged charcoal-and-rose pigment boundary immediately right of the large cream-haloed eye and Broad ragged rose-to-charcoal pigment boundary beside the large cream-haloed pupil.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
